name: Possessed Daeodons

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-15: Cleansing the Flame

stealth.details: or Detect Magic to notice the heavy divine magic in the area

disable: DC 21 Occultism check or DC 21 Religion check to disrupt the magic animating the spirits, DC 25 Athletics check to hold down one of the daeodons, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank, counteract DC 25). 3 successes are required.
reset: The hazard resets within 24 hours if the cultists of Sezelrian still remain in the area.
routine: (three actions) The animated daeodons trample all creatures within the circle, dealing 2d8+9 bludgeoning damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Fires of Sabotage
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area of the ritual circle

---

Effect The outline of the circle alights with fire dealing 4d6 fire damage to all creatures within it (DC 24 basic Reflex save save). The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Three daeodon corpses, animated and enraged by Sezelrian's divine intervention, trample anything within the ritual circle.
